destinations.entry_condition: Deploy into XLV or shortlist leaders once S&P 500 breadth >50D SMA recovers above 45% or XLV prints an accumulation reversal above $178.50.

destinations.entry_condition: Accumulate LLY on pullbacks into $1,266-$1,310 with structural stop below $1,150.00.

destinations.recommendation: 0% allocation to Vanguard Health Care ETF (VHT) at $326.69.
destinations.rationale: VHT carries a 0.988 daily return correlation with XLV, a slightly higher 0.09% expense ratio (vs 0.08%), and lower options liquidity ($20.80B AUM vs $46.92B), offering no risk-adjusted edge over XLV.
destinations.entry_condition: Not selected; use XLV for large-cap Health Care beta.

The ETF earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS quality verdict on durable demand, high cash conversion, and unmatched sector liquidity. We rate XLV ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP ($170.71–$178.50 entry, $162.04 stop, $206.00 base target) after a -5.95% pullback.
